description: This file contains the implementation of the LocalReminderService class, which manages in-memory and scheduled reminders within the Orleans distributed framework. It handles registration, unregistration, periodic reminder firing, and synchronization with a global reminder table, including lifecycle participation and internal timer management.

classes.name: LocalReminderData
classes.description: Represents a local in-memory reminder, managing its scheduling, execution, and lifecycle, including timer management and reminder tick handling.

classes.name: ReminderIdentity
classes.description: A value type struct used as a unique identifier for reminders, combining GrainId and ReminderName.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the reminder service by starting the reminder table asynchronously.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Gracefully stops the reminder service, disposing timers and stopping reminders.

methods.name: RegisterOrUpdateReminder
methods.description: Registers a new reminder or updates an existing one, including updating the external reminder table and starting local timers.

methods.name: UnregisterReminder
methods.description: Removes a reminder both locally and from the external reminder table.

methods.name: GetReminder
methods.description: Retrieves a specific reminder by grain ID and reminder name from the reminder table.

methods.name: GetReminders
methods.description: Retrieves all reminders associated with a specific grain ID.

methods.name: ReadAndUpdateReminders
methods.description: Fetches reminders from the global table and updates local state accordingly.

methods.name: ReadTableAndStartTimers
methods.description: Reads reminders from a specific range in the table and starts timers for new or updated reminders.

methods.name: StartAndAddTimer
methods.description: Creates and starts a timer for a reminder entry, replacing any existing timer for the same reminder.

methods.name: TryStopPreviousTimer
methods.description: Stops the timer for a specific reminder if it exists locally.

methods.name: DoResponsibilitySanityCheck
methods.description: Checks if the current silo is responsible for the given grain ID before proceeding with reminder operations.

methods.name: PrintReminders
methods.description: Outputs the current list of local reminders for debugging purposes.

methods.name: GetGrain
methods.description: Creates a reference to a grain implementing IRemindable based on its GrainId.
